conservative.read: This plan aims for capital preservation, targeting around 1.5% monthly growth. It significantly reduces leverage and focuses on broad market exposure and income. Expect lower potential gains but also a much lower risk of significant drawdowns.

balanced.read: This balanced plan targets around 2.5% monthly growth by reducing leverage and concentration while adding a quality tech name. It aims for risk-first growth, expecting moderate returns with controlled volatility. The cash buffer is around 10%.

plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU, METU, PLTU, MSFU) to zero.

income.read: This income-focused plan targets around 1% monthly distributions by rotating into income-generating ETFs like QQQI and broad index ETFs. It minimizes leverage and high-beta single names for low drawdown. While distributions are prioritized, NAV can still decline in market downturns.
